Private callable MCP tools for Machine Legal MAXVAR registry lookup and bounded research dependency planning.

Prepare private hash-bound records and spreadsheet CSV. New work uses TYPED_V2 for exact native identity, numeric order and registered references. Explicit PRIVATE_WITH_DASH_REFERENCES plus CREATE/REUSE/ADVANCE produces a UUID-only projection and separate private resolver; never upload the entire result to Dash.
